create_RotMatWignerCudaGraph: create a RotMatWignerCudaGraph instance to use CUDA graphs for accelerated Wigner matrix creation on GPU
get_rotmat_and_wigner: call get_rotmat_and_wigner on RotMatWignerCudaGraph with edge distance vectors and JD buffers to get Wigner matrices
capture_rotmat_and_wigner_with_make_grap: capture rotation matrix and Wigner computation into a CUDA graphed callable for faster repeated inference
edge_rot_and_wigner_graph_capture_region: compute Wigner matrices and their inverses from edge distance vectors and Jd buffers using Euler angle decomposition
init_edge_rot_euler_angles_wigner_cuda_g: compute Euler angles alpha, beta, gamma and a north pole mask from 3D edge distance vectors for Wigner rotation
